record.question: Seven boys A, B, C, D, E, F and G are standing in a line. G is between A and E. F and A have one boy between them. E and C have two boys between them. D is to the immediate right of F. C and B have three boys between them. Who is sitting in the middle?
record.explanation: The unique order satisfying all five position clues is B-E-G-A-C-F-D; A is fourth, in the middle. Derived from the printed paper; an exact source-verified official key is not attached to this claim.
